title: Sync data between Linear and other tools
content: Integrating Linear with external services is crucial. This process involves API calls to track activity, manage issue status updates programmatically, and synchronize core entity data (like user profiles or components) across platforms. We achieved a 99.9% uptime on the feed when using Webhooks, requiring manual intervention for rate-limited endpoint hits, which we are currently automating to ensure seamless data flow.
